title: Mask My File
hero: Find private details, choose exactly what to hide, and share a verified copy without losing the context people need.
formatsTitle: One private workflow for every file
formatsText: Preview images and PDFs at full width, zoom up to 5×, and draw exact areas by hand. Search every match in Text, JSON, XML, HTML, CSV, TSV, and RTF, then use stars, partial masks, placeholders, pseudonyms, or removal. Metadata is stripped wherever the format allows.
verifyText: Mask My File writes a brand-new copy, reopens it, and confirms the protected file is still valid before it shows Private Ready. Your original is never touched.
batchText: Give every file its own preview and manual selections, search the same private text across the whole set, then export all the verified copies in one pass.
supportTitle: Protect a file in three clear steps
supportIntro: Reach for Mask My File before sending a rental application, a medical record, a customer file, a screenshot, or anything that carries details others do not need to see.
step1: Pick a photo, PDF, document, structured-data file, or pasted text. Scanning starts locally on your device right away.
step2: Review every finding, add anything that was missed or draw an exact area, then choose a protection style that the file type supports.
step3: Create the protected copy and share it only after Private Ready confirms the new output reopened and passed its check.
faqText: It means the freshly protected copy was rendered, reopened, and checked for a valid file structure. It never replaces your own final look before you share.
contactText: Email hourstag.app@gmail.com with your device model, iOS version, file type, and a short note about what you were doing.
privacyIntro: Mask My File is built to protect files without ever collecting them. No account is required, and the app carries no advertising, tracking, analytics, or content-upload service.
deviceText: Apple Vision and the embedded Tesseract OCR engine scan the content you pick locally. Masking, redaction, metadata removal, export, and verification all run on the device too.
faceText: Face detection only marks image regions for you to review. Mask My File never identifies people, builds a biometric or identity template, uploads face data, shares it, or keeps separate face data.
storeTitle: Purchases are the only network call
storeText: Apple processes the optional lifetime purchase and restore through StoreKit. Mask My File uses no VPN, NetworkExtension, proxy, tunnel, DNS filter, or network routing of any kind.
retentionText: Originals are never overwritten. Temporary workspace files, saved projects, Placeholder Vault mappings, and Private Session data remain only as each feature explains. Delete them in the app or remove the app to wipe its local container.
